## SETUP REQUIRED — Vapi server-event receiver

This workflow is **inactive** and contains no secrets or IDs.

1. Create an n8n **Header Auth** credential with header name `X-Vapi-Secret` and a strong random value, then attach it to **Vapi Server Event Webhook**.
2. In Vapi, create a Custom Credential that sends the same `X-Vapi-Secret` value (no Bearer prefix) and reference that credential in the assistant/phone-number Server URL configuration.
3. Set the public production webhook URL as the Vapi Server URL and select at least `assistant-request`, `status-update`, and `end-of-call-report`. Vapi sends them as `body.message.type`.
4. Put the saved inbound assistant ID into **Normalize and Route Vapi Event** only if you use dynamic assistant selection. An `assistant-request` must be answered within 7.5 seconds; this workflow responds before any external request.
5. Configure `analysis_webhook_url`, attach a separate Header Auth credential to **Forward Final Event to Analysis**, then set `analysis_forwarding_enabled` to `true`.
6. Do not persist raw transcripts or phone numbers in routine logs. Review recording consent and retention rules before enabling artifacts.

Official references: https://docs.vapi.ai/server-url/events and https://docs.vapi.ai/server-url/server-authentication
